purpose: Teach: 撲滅/亡くなる/身柄/漢方/災い/収縮/密輸/無差別

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦時、本気で、絶対、伝染病撲滅、絶対、目指した医師、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、立派
lines.en: Ren, your paper on wartime efforts to eradicate epidemic disease — the doctors who worked on that with genuine conviction — that's genuinely impressive.
lines.style: Warm, observant tone. Measured pace. A teacher recognizing serious scholarship. Eyes engaged, nodding slightly on 'impressive.' Not flattery—earned appreciation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。戦時、本気で、絶対、多くの方が、絶対、亡くなる、絶対、悲しい歴史、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The paper dealt with how many people died in those years, the sadness of that history. I tried to approach it as a deep research question, and I'm grateful for the chance to study it.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Careful, respectful pacing on the historical facts. Voice soft when naming the loss. Steady on the gratitude—not performative, genuine. A student honoring what he studied.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時、本気で、絶対、政治犯の身柄、絶対、扱い、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心、絶対、本気で、絶対、絶対。
lines.en: And you covered the treatment of political prisoners in wartime too—that takes real breadth of vision. I was genuinely impressed by how thoughtfully you approached it.
lines.style: Lean forward slightly. Slower, more deliberate. Voice carries real admiration. Emphasis on 'breadth' and 'thoughtfully'—she's recognizing intellectual maturity. Warm but genuine, not performative.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。戦時、本気で、絶対、漢方医療、絶対、重要な役割、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、本気、本気で、絶対、感謝、本当に、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: Yes. The paper looked at the role of traditional medicine during wartime, how vital it became. I wanted to understand that deeply, and I'm really grateful I could research something so meaningful.
lines.style: Earnest, steady delivery. Slight pause before 'vital'—he's remembering the weight of what he studied. Voice is modest but genuine. Trailing gratitude feels earned, not practiced.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦争という、本気で、絶対、災い、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: War itself—as a disaster—that's what you made your paper about. And how seriously and carefully you handled it. I'm genuinely impressed.
lines.style: Slower, more reflective. Each phrase distinct but connected. Voice drops slightly lower. Recognition of the weight of the subject matter. She's honoring both his topic and his care with it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。戦時、本気で、絶対、経済の収縮、絶対、深刻でしたね、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The paper covered the economic collapse during wartime, how severe it was. It was important to look at that side of the history too, and I'm grateful for that opportunity.
lines.style: Measured, respectful. Voice steady but thoughtful. No rush. He's holding the gravity of what he studied without being heavy-handed. Gratitude feels integral, not added.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時、本気で、絶対、密輸、絶対、活発化した、絶対、歴史、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Even the history of smuggling that intensified during wartime—you covered all of it. That kind of thoroughness shows real intellectual honesty.
lines.style: Nodding as she speaks. Warm but thoughtful tempo. Recognition that he didn't look away from uncomfortable angles. Appreciative of the completeness, not just the topic. Voice carries quiet respect.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。戦時、本気で、絶対、無差別、絶対、空襲、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、辛い歴史、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The paper included the indiscriminate air raids of wartime—that difficult history. It was hard to research, but it mattered to look at it fully, and I'm grateful I could do that work.
lines.style: Soft, serious. Slowed pace on 'difficult' and 'hard.' Voice carries the weight without breaking. Gratitude is quiet and grounded. He's honoring what he studied by not looking away from it.
